difference_from_nearest: BOSARO changes uncertainty-set geometry from support erosion; BMCAPL changes the policy action/update feasible set from decision-tipping distance.
external_prior_art: Uncertainty-aware/adaptive trust-region policy optimization already adapts permitted policy movement to estimation uncertainty.
mechanism_removing_comparator: same CAPL shell with fixed base turnover independent of BMDT tipping distance
new_failure_mode: A policy learner may satisfy static action constraints yet make an update whose allowed turnover is too large relative to the nearest belief change that flips the downstream decision.
non_additive_interaction: BMDT decision-tipping distance continuously contracts CAPL maximum-turnover feasibility before policy optimization; it changes the feasible action set, not only a report or binary gate.
